accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding Pokhran-I is correct?
o: It comprised five fission and fusion devices led by A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.
It was conducted on 18 May 1974 under Prime Minister Indira Gandhi and was described as a peaceful nuclear explosion.
It was conducted on 11 May 1998 under Prime Minister A.B. Vajpayee as a thermonuclear test.
It was conducted at Pokhran under Prime Minister Morarji Desai as Operation Shakti.
accepted.x: Pokhran-I took place on 18 May 1974 under Prime Minister Indira Gandhi and was officially described as a peaceful nuclear explosion. The other options refer to features of Pokhran-II or contain incorrect details.
accepted.tq: Use the date, Prime Minister and official description together to eliminate mixed-up details.
accepted.sec: Nuclear tests - Pokhran I and II

accepted.s: The team associated with the conduct of Pokhran-I was led by:
accepted.x: Raja Ramanna led the scientific team associated with Pokhran-I in 1974. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam and R. Chidambaram were associated with Pokhran-II.
accepted.tq: Apply the APPSC person-with-deed trap by matching the scientist with the correct test.
accepted.sec: Nuclear tests - Pokhran I and II

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Pokhran-II:
1. It was conducted under Prime Minister A.B. Vajpayee.
2. The scientific leadership included A.P.J. Abdul Kalam and R. Chidambaram.
3. It involved both fission and fusion devices.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Pokhran-II was conducted under A.B. Vajpayee, involved A.P.J. Abdul Kalam and R. Chidambaram, and included fission as well as fusion devices.
accepted.tq: Check each statement independently before selecting the comprehensive combination.
accepted.sec: Nuclear tests - Pokhran I and II

accepted.s: Both Pokhran-I and Pokhran-II were conducted at the Pokhran Test Range located in:
accepted.x: Both nuclear tests were conducted at the Pokhran Test Range in Jaisalmer district of Rajasthan.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the precise district from nearby Rajasthan locations.
accepted.sec: Nuclear tests - Pokhran I and II

accepted.s: 11 May is observed in India as:
accepted.x: 11 May is observed as National Technology Day in India, commemorating the 1998 Pokhran tests.
accepted.tq: Use the exact official observance name rather than a plausible substitute.
accepted.sec: Nuclear tests - Pokhran I and II

accepted.s: Which of the following air-defence systems is of Russian origin and is a long-range surface-to-air missile system?
accepted.x: The S-400 Triumf is a Russian-origin long-range surface-to-air missile system. Barak-1 and MRSAM are associated with Israel or India-Israel cooperation, while Akash Tarang is an indigenous electronic-warfare system.
accepted.tq: Match the system with its country of origin and type.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s:
With reference to the S-400 Triumf, consider the following statements:
1. China was its third operator after Russia and Belarus.
2. Turkey and India are among its operators.
3. The Indian Air Force refers to its S-400 system as ‘Sudarshan Chakra’.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Russia and Belarus were followed by China as an operator, and Turkey and India later joined the list; the IAF calls its system Sudarshan Chakra.
accepted.tq: Combine operator-list facts with the Indian designation without reversing the sequence.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: Barak-1 is best described as a:
o: High-power laser weapon developed by DRDO
Indigenous anti-drone electronic-warfare system of the Air Force
Long-range ballistic missile interceptor of the Indian Army
Ship-based point-defence surface-to-air missile system of the Indian Navy
accepted.x: Barak-1 is an Israeli-origin, ship-based point-defence surface-to-air missile system operated by the Navy.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct combination of platform, role and service operator.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: MRSAM or Barak-8 has been developed through cooperation between:
accepted.x: MRSAM/Barak-8 is an India-Israel programme involving DRDO and Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI).
accepted.tq: Use the development-agency trap to distinguish DRDO-IAI cooperation from other partnerships.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Akashteer — BEL and the Indian Army
Akash Tarang — anti-drone soft-kill electronic-warfare system
IADWS — ship-based point-defence system of the Navy
IADWS — DRDO indigenous integrated air-defence system
accepted.x: IADWS is an indigenous, multi-layered integrated air-defence weapon system developed by DRDO; it is not a ship-based point-defence system. Akashteer is associated with BEL and the Army, while Akash Tarang jams drone-control signals.
accepted.tq: Find the mismatched authority or platform rather than selecting the familiar system name.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: The Integrated Air Defence Weapon System (IADWS) comprises:
o: QRSAM, VSHORADS and a high-power laser directed-energy weapon
PAD, AAD and Swordfish radar only
MRSAM, BrahMos and a nuclear-powered interceptor
accepted.x: IADWS is a multi-layered indigenous system comprising QRSAM, VSHORADS and a high-power laser directed-energy weapon.
accepted.tq: Test the system’s component combination instead of its country of origin.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: The maiden flight test of the Integrated Air Defence Weapon System was conducted in:
accepted.x: The maiden flight test of IADWS took place in August 2025.
accepted.tq: Separate the close test, approval and interest dates associated with different systems.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about Akashteer is correct?
o: It is an anti-drone system that exclusively destroys drones through missiles.
It is a naval version of the Barak-8 missile.
It is an automated air-defence control network developed by BEL with the Indian Army.
It is a Russian long-range surface-to-air missile system.
accepted.x: Akashteer is an automated air-defence control network associated with BEL and the Indian Army. It is distinct from the missile and soft-kill systems listed in the other options.
accepted.tq: Identify the system from its institutional developer and operational function.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: Mission Sudarshan Chakra, under Vision 2035, is intended to create a comprehensive national shield integrating:
o: Coastal radar, naval aviation and aircraft carriers
Space launch vehicles, weather satellites and navigation satellites
Only nuclear weapons and submarine-launched missiles
accepted.x: Mission Sudarshan Chakra is envisaged as a networked national shield integrating air defence, cybersecurity and surveillance.
accepted.tq: Reject the ‘only’ formulation and select the stated multi-domain purpose.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: Which of the following systems are identified as building blocks of Mission Sudarshan Chakra?
o: INS Arihant, INS Arighaat and INS Aridhaman
accepted.x: Akash Tarang, MRSAM and VSHORADS are identified as building blocks of Mission Sudarshan Chakra.
accepted.tq: Match the mission with its component systems, not with unrelated strategic platforms.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: Project Kusha is associated with a DRDO long-range air-defence project having interceptor ranges of approximately:
accepted.x: Project Kusha is reported as a long-range air-defence project with M1, M2 and M3 interceptors of about 150, 250 and 350–400 km ranges, respectively.
accepted.tq: Read the range progression carefully and avoid confusing interceptor ranges with missile ranges.
accepted.sec: Air defence systems - origin and operators

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly distinguishes fission and fusion weapons?
o: Fission splits a heavy nucleus, whereas fusion combines light nuclei.
Fusion uses a heavy nucleus as the sole explosive material without a primary.
Fission combines light nuclei, whereas fusion splits heavy nuclei.
Both fission and fusion involve only chemical chain reactions.
accepted.x: A fission weapon splits a heavy nucleus such as U-235 or Pu-239, whereas a fusion weapon combines light hydrogen isotopes. Fusion requires a fission primary to provide the initiating heat.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the paired processes by focusing on split versus fuse.
accepted.sec: Nuclear weapon technology terms

accepted.s: In a thermonuclear weapon, the fission primary primarily serves to:
o: Act as a radar-guided delivery system
Absorb all neutrons and stop the reaction
accepted.x: The fission primary supplies the heat required to trigger the fusion reaction in a thermonuclear weapon.
accepted.tq: Apply the cause-and-effect relationship between the primary stage and fusion.
accepted.sec: Nuclear weapon technology terms

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with its approximate U-235 enrichment level?
accepted.x: Natural uranium contains about 0.7% U-235. Reactor-grade LEU is about 3–5%, HEU is 20% or more, and weapons-grade uranium is about 90%.
accepted.tq: Compare the enrichment categories in ascending order rather than relying on the labels alone.
accepted.sec: Nuclear weapon technology terms

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding uranium enrichment:
1. Reactor-grade low-enriched uranium generally contains 3–5% U-235.
2. Highly enriched uranium contains 20% or more U-235.
3. Weapons-grade uranium contains approximately 90% U-235.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly state the approximate enrichment levels of reactor-grade LEU, HEU and weapons-grade uranium.
accepted.tq: Check the numerical bands individually; all three belong to the same enrichment scale.
accepted.sec: Nuclear weapon technology terms

accepted.s: In U-235 fission, the impact of a neutron can produce:
o: Electrons that directly sustain a chemical reaction
Two smaller nuclei and two or three neutrons that help sustain the chain reaction
One larger nucleus and no additional neutrons
Hydrogen isotopes and a fusion primary only
accepted.x: A neutron striking U-235 can split it into two smaller nuclei, such as barium and krypton, while releasing two or three neutrons that sustain the chain reaction.
accepted.tq: Follow the particle-level sequence from neutron impact to chain reaction.
accepted.sec: Nuclear weapon technology terms

accepted.s: Which device is described as a high-speed switch used to fire the detonators of a nuclear bomb?
accepted.x: A krytron is a high-speed switch used to fire nuclear-bomb detonators. MOSFETs, solid-state relays and solenoids are specifically distinguished from it in this context.
accepted.tq: Use precise technical terminology to distinguish the specialised device from ordinary switching components.
accepted.sec: Nuclear weapon technology terms

accepted.s: INS Arihant is designated S2 and is best described as:
accepted.x: INS Arihant, commissioned in 2016, is India’s first indigenous SSBN. The other options refer to conventional or leased submarine categories.
accepted.tq: Distinguish submarine type and origin instead of treating every naval submarine as an SSBN.
accepted.sec: Nuclear submarines - Arihant class, leased SSNs, K-series, ATV

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the missile-carrying configuration of INS Arihant?
o: Two vertical launch systems carrying only K-5 missiles
Eight vertical launch systems capable of carrying 24 K-15 or 8 K-4/K-5 missiles
Four vertical launch systems capable of carrying 12 K-15 or 4 K-4 missiles
Four vertical launch systems carrying only conventional cruise missiles
accepted.x: INS Arihant has four vertical launch systems and can carry 12 K-15 or 4 K-4 missiles. The eight-VLS configuration belongs to INS Aridhaman as described.
accepted.tq: Compare the close Arihant-class specifications rather than transferring figures between boats.
accepted.sec: Nuclear submarines - Arihant class, leased SSNs, K-series, ATV

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding INS Arighaat is correct?
o: It is designated S4 and has eight vertical launch systems.
It is designated S3, was commissioned in 2024, and had the K-4 tested from it.
It is a German Type 209 conventional submarine commissioned before 1988.
It is designated S2 and was commissioned in 2016 as the first indigenous SSBN.
accepted.x: INS Arighaat is designated S3, was commissioned in 2024, is of similar size to Arihant, and had the K-4 tested from it.
accepted.tq: Match the boat designation, commissioning year and distinguishing test event.
accepted.sec: Nuclear submarines - Arihant class, leased SSNs, K-series, ATV

accepted.s: The ATV project was undertaken primarily to develop:
o: Indigenous SSBNs with DRDO and private-sector participation and Russian assistance
A network of anti-drone systems with Israel Aerospace Industries
A long-range air-defence radar with the United States
A conventional submarine fleet based entirely on German designs
accepted.x: The Advanced Technology Vessel project was initiated more than three decades ago by DRDO and private firms, with Russian assistance, to build SSBNs.
accepted.tq: Identify the project from its objective and institutional partnership.
accepted.sec: Nuclear submarines - Arihant class, leased SSNs, K-series, ATV

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: INS Chakra — leased Charlie-class submarine; INS Chakra II — leased Russian Akula-class submarine
INS Chakra — German Type 209; INS Chakra II — Kilo-class submarine
INS Chakra — indigenous SSBN; INS Chakra II — conventional diesel-electric submarine
INS Chakra — Arihant-class boat; INS Chakra II — Barak-class submarine
accepted.x: INS Chakra was a leased Charlie-class submarine obtained in 1988, while INS Chakra II was the Russian Akula-class boat formerly known as Nerpa.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair linking each leased submarine with its class.
accepted.sec: Nuclear submarines - Arihant class, leased SSNs, K-series, ATV

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: INS Shishumar — German Type 209 conventional submarine
INS Sindhuvir — Russian Kilo-class, Sindhughosh-class submarine
INS Shalki — German Type 209 conventional submarine
accepted.x: INS Shalki is a German Type 209 conventional diesel-electric submarine, not an Arihant-class SSBN. INS Shishumar is also Type 209, while INS Sindhuvir belongs to the Russian Kilo/Sindhughosh class.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong submarine classification among closely related naval platforms.
accepted.sec: Nuclear submarines - Arihant class, leased SSNs, K-series, ATV

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly matches the K-series SLBM with its approximate range or status?
o: K-15 — designed exclusively for surface ships
K-5 and K-6 — already operational with a range of 3,500 km
accepted.x: The K-15 Sagarika has an approximate range of 750 km. K-4 has a range of about 3,500 km, while K-5 and K-6 are longer-range systems under development.
accepted.tq: Match each missile to its range and development status without reversing the K-series.
accepted.sec: Nuclear submarines - Arihant class, leased SSNs, K-series, ATV

accepted.s: The K-series of submarine-launched ballistic missiles is named after:
accepted.x: The K-series is named after Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.
accepted.tq: Apply the person-name association specific to the missile series.
accepted.sec: Nuclear submarines - Arihant class, leased SSNs, K-series, ATV

accepted.s: India’s ballistic missile defence system is organised into which two interception layers?
accepted.x: India’s BMD system has two tiers: exo-atmospheric interception outside the atmosphere and endo-atmospheric interception within the atmosphere.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the atmospheric boundary from deployment or warhead classifications.
accepted.sec: Ballistic Missile Defence - two tiers, interceptors, Phase II

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly matches the BMD interceptor with its tier?
o: PAD — exo-atmospheric interception at higher altitude
PAD — endo-atmospheric interception at lower altitude
AAD — exo-atmospheric interception at higher altitude
accepted.x: PAD, or Prithvi Air Defence, is the higher-altitude exo-atmospheric interceptor. AAD is the lower-altitude endo-atmospheric interceptor, while Swordfish is a tracking radar.
accepted.tq: Start with the altitude clue and then distinguish interceptor from radar.
accepted.sec: Ballistic Missile Defence - two tiers, interceptors, Phase II

accepted.s: AD-1 and AD-2 are associated with which phase of India’s BMD programme?
o: Phase II, aimed at longer-range threats of about the 5,000-km class
The initial exo-atmospheric tier for short-range threats only
accepted.x: AD-1 and AD-2 are Phase II BMD interceptors intended to address longer-range threats, including those in approximately the 5,000-km class.
accepted.tq: Separate the Phase II interceptor pair from the first-tier PAD/AAD systems.
accepted.sec: Ballistic Missile Defence - two tiers, interceptors, Phase II

accepted.s: The Swordfish radar is primarily used to:
o: Jam drone-control signals at short range
Track ballistic missiles and space objects at distances exceeding 1,500 km
accepted.x: The Long-Range Tracking Radar, known as Swordfish, tracks ballistic missiles and space objects at distances of more than 1,500 km.
accepted.tq: Identify the sensor by its tracking function and range rather than by the interceptor it supports.
accepted.sec: Ballistic Missile Defence - two tiers, interceptors, Phase II

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the June 2026 BMD demonstration is correct?
o: It was the maiden test of the K-15 from INS Arihant.
It concerned only the procurement approval of MRSAM by the DAC.
It demonstrated a multi-layered BMD system in which interceptors destroyed their targets and indicated capability against threats up to ICBM class.
It demonstrated only a conventional submarine-launched missile with no interception component.
accepted.x: In June 2026, DRDO demonstrated a multi-layered BMD system with interceptors destroying targets, placing India among the few countries capable of engaging threats up to ICBM class.
accepted.tq: Separate a live capability demonstration from procurement, submarine and anti-ship events.
accepted.sec: Ballistic Missile Defence - two tiers, interceptors, Phase II

accepted.s: The maiden test of NASM-MR, mentioned in connection with the June 2026 test series, involved a:
o: Naval anti-ship missile of medium range
accepted.x: NASM-MR stands for a naval anti-ship missile of medium range, whose maiden test took place in the same series as the June 2026 BMD demonstration.
accepted.tq: Break the acronym into its platform and role to avoid confusing it with a BMD interceptor.
accepted.sec: Ballistic Missile Defence - two tiers, interceptors, Phase II
